verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a PM replying to a customer from inside a feedback record. The 'close the loop' claim refers to linking specs, shipped work and outcomes, not customer replies. The other related items don't qualify either: feedback CRUD via the API, comment threads on documents, and Slack messaging through Spark are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an in-record customer reply.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop
